Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. M.C. Kandpal, learned Senior
Counsel assisted by Mr. Ajay Kumar
Bahuguna, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
2. Ms. Suniti Bhatt, learned Central
Government Standing Counsel for the
Union of India
3. Mr. Devendra Pant, learned
Standing Counsel for the State of
Uttarakhand.
4. According to petitioner, Officials of
Indian Railways are trying to encroach
upon her land which was purchased by a
registered sale deed, executed on
07.10.1999. As per the sale deed, which
is on record as Annexure 1 to the writ
petition, petitioner purchased 684 sq.
meter land situate in Village Shekhupura
Kankhal, Pargana Jwalapur, District
Haridwar.
5. Ms. Suniti Bhatt, learned counsel
appearing for Union of India submits that
on the date Mr. Naresh Kumar Dhiman
allegedly transferred the land in question
in favour of petitioner, he did not have
any holding in his name, as he had
transferred his entire share earlier.

UKHC010156742026
2026:UHC:8887
6. Learned Senior Counsel appearing
for the petitioner submits that petitioner
be permitted to make representation to
District Magistrate, Haridwar, highlighting
her grievance.
7. Accordingly, the writ petition is
disposed of with liberty to petitioner to
make representation to District
Magistrate, Haridwar. If petitioner makes
representation within two weeks,
decision thereupon shall be taken, as per
law, within nine months thereafter. It
goes without saying that representative
of General Manager (Northern Railways)
shall also be heard before taking any
decision.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
